package.name: r2lp1_planning
package.description: Phase 1 (if-else) stand-in for the reinforcement-learning planner: subscribes to module_integrate_node's synced /integrate/chameleon_in JSON and publishes a target speed/steering Twist on /autoware/control. Decision logic is isolated from ROS plumbing so Phase 2 can swap in an RL policy without touching the node.
